title: Primary and coupled peak L5/S1 moments in maximal extension exertion (upright standing), males
condition: isometric maximal extension exertion, upright standing, feet/knees/pelvis fixed, thorax in frame; 1D feedback (primary plane)

quantity.name: MVC moment (primary and coupled, absolute)
quantity.definition: peak L5/S1 moments over all MVC trials in that direction (3-5 trials); all values absolute (positive); pct_of_same_plane_MVC = coupled moment as % of the maximal strength in that plane (Table 1 italics), not % of primary

source.authors: Lariviere C, Gagnon D, Genest K
source.sample: 20 right-handed healthy males; healthy right-handed men, BMI<28, no back pain in previous year, in vivo

protocol.summary: Triaxial static dynamometer (AMTI MC6-6-1000 force platform on a steel frame) stabilising feet, knees and pelvis (Lariviere 2001); thorax embedded in a frame fixed on the platform; L5/S1 moments at 50 Hz; upright standing posture. MVCs in 6 directions (latin-square order) with visual feedback of the primary-plane moment and Baratta's protocol (target raised by 10% until failure, up to 5 trials, 5-7 s ramps), strong verbal encouragement, 2 min rest.
how_to_simulate: Upright standing, pelvis fixed, thorax loaded through a rigid harness/frame.
Apply the measured primary extension moment at L5/S1 (plus coupled moments of the magnitudes given; their signs are not reported).
Compare the model's maximal primary moment (or required max muscle stress) and coupled L5/S1 moments with data.
protocol.notes: Coupled moments are absolute values (signs not reported) - do not pool with signed means. Same subjects as Lariviere 2014 (20 men, 25±3 y, same dynamometer, 3 sessions; 2009 reports session 1 MVC). Extension MVC also at start/end of protocol: 274±69 and 275±64 Nm (text).

extraction.check_notes: Re-read Table 1 in text layout; numbers also match the copy in Ghezelbash 2018 Table 2 (Lariviere rows).

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD for primary; coupled within 1 SD
